Installing an Android APK

  1. Choose the platform you want and download its APK.
  2. Open the downloaded file on your Android device.
  3. If Android asks for installation permission, review the source and permissions before continuing. Do not bypass a security warning.
  4. Follow the installation prompts, then open the app.

APK files are for Android. This page does not provide an iPhone installation file.

If a download does not open

Check your connection and available storage, then retry the link for the same platform. For help, use the FAQ and contact links.
